SELECT car_names.Model, cars_data.Horsepower
FROM cars_data
JOIN car_names ON cars_data.Id = car_names.MakeId
WHERE cars_data.Cylinders = 4
  AND CAST(cars_data.Horsepower AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(Horsepower AS INTEGER))
      FROM cars_data
      WHERE Cylinders = 4
  );
